traceabilityChecks.summary: REQ-008's old-path claim holds exactly, and the pin records agree with the changelog.
Every re-pin task line carries an observed result with a commit id or run id, and the one blocked task is recorded in five places.
The vendored doctor skill file is byte-identical to Skilled at the pin, so the skill surface traces to the commit it claims.
